Victim has mental illness (schizophrenia) with partial self-defense ability. He voluntarily surrendered, confessed, victim's family compensated and forgave.

What crime? This is sexual assault: forced sexual contact, likely "强奸" (rape) or "强制猥亵" (forced indecency). Since he touched chest and genitals, but no penetration. Under Chinese law, forced indecency (强制猥亵) is defined as using violence, threat, or other means to force a victim to have sexual contact (touching sexual parts).
